COMMITTING: git push is 403 'denied to Onyx-Node' for the fixer too, not only for subagents - the App has no write access to kavopdf/app over HTTPS git. It is not a dead end: the GitHub MCP tool GITHUB_COMMIT_MULTIPLE_FILES (owner kavopdf, repo app, branch main, upserts=[{path,content,encoding:utf-8}]) commits several files atomically and worked for all four commits of this run. The next run should commit that way, then 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' so HEAD matches origin, then chain.py. chain.py's sync check is strict SHA equality and also refuses a dirty tree, and it rewrites CHAIN.json - so commit CHAIN.json again after each chain.py run.

next: Do NOT re-open the squeeze or the anchor rule on itr-computation-with-slab-table - both are measured and refuted (FINDINGS/itr-slab-the-squeeze-is-not-the-defect-1645.md). The largest single term there is the cell baseline: cellBeforeTw's fallback is LINE_BASE*(rowLineTw - cellBoxTw) and rowLineTw is the cell's LINE capped at 200 twips, not the row's pitch, so in a tall row (18.4 pt) every cell lands 5.2 pt high. Screen that on the table documents that already score well (320_balance_sheet_statutory, 404_sudoku_grid, 42_table_coloured_header_alternating_rows) BEFORE touching it - it changes every table on the corpus. Second, and cheaper: the class still needs the human decision in BLOCKERS 14:50 (6 of 7 documents are already under 5.0; attempt.py's bar cannot close it). Third: measure_doc_chunked reports pages_done=160 pages_total=300 beside a complete result and pages_compared=1200 - check its accumulator before the next 300-page document.
